honesty: Every answer is a sentence already in Contact Path, or this lab’s own note about Lucky. If the question is not in the list, the bot says it does not know.

entries.a: Overall priority is (time in minutes × acceleration) + initial priority. The classroom example is initial 4, acceleration 1, and 3 minutes, which is 7.

entries.a: Proficiency 1 is best and 20 is worst. REQAGENT opens a window. UpdateContact can widen it.
On a Personal Connection skill, acceleration is forced to 0 so outbound dialing does not age like an inbound queue.
Hold audio, including hold music, is not recorded. A consultation during hold is recorded.
Since Summer 2023, new inbound digital work uses skills and scripts. Contact Path does not teach a new routing queue for that path.
A contact hits one point of contact, one script, and one starting skill. The script may retarget the skill before an agent is offered the contact.
IP voice registration on the ports page is SIP to destination ports 5060 and 5061. Hardphones also need NTP UDP 123. RTP and SRTP use UDP 1024–65535.
Screen monitoring uses outbound TCP 443 and UDP 443 or 3478 for WebRTC NAT traversal. Port 31322 is internal to the agent PC and is not required with OS Login.
Emergency dialing uses an outbound voice skill, a verified address, and 911 or the local number. 933 is the no-charge test named on the page.
AutoSummary types named on the help page are Structured, Generative, and Hybrid. Email is not supported.
A back-end app on the auth page uses the password grant. tenantId comes from the ID token. The example host is not every tenant, so this lab says to discover api_endpoint.
Back-end integrations on the auth page use the password grant. A person in a browser follows the authorization-code branch. This lab does not copy the password sample into a user app.
The 26.3 page was revised to 2 September 2026 through 5 November 2026. Coming Soon for 26.4 begins 26 October 2026. The windows overlap, and this lab does not pick a winner.
A WFM connector, Multi-ACD recording, and Migrated Calls are three different moves. Contact Path does not fold them into one cutover.
Forecast volume and average handle time, then staff to a target. CXone WFM and IEX are different products in this lab.

Dynamic delivery routes on how long an agent has been Available and on proficiency. Automatic delivery paces about every 15 seconds. Agent-request delivery waits for Request Interaction, or +1 Contact in MAX.
Real-time adherence updates every few seconds. Intraday updates every 15 minutes and can reforecast the rest of the day.

On the Quality Management welcome page, Sanity QA's percentages 60 and 80 average to 70. The same points, 11 of 15, print as 73.3333. Widgets default to the average of values. Vijay's two pairs on that page do not match, so this lab does not pick one.

The opened Salesforce pages describe an embedded agent and a fully integrated Lightning agent. Those are two procedures. CPaaS has no opened page in this lab, so that line is confirm and has no URL. 1CX is UCaaS, not CPaaS.

cite.title: Install Agent Workspace (Embedded) (Agent Embedded) in Salesforce

entries.a: The Agentic Engagement Plane page opened. It is an orchestration layer above CCaaS. The pillars are Any Channel, Any AI Agent, and Any Human Agent. The page does not list admin clicks.

steps.say: Start on Contact Path. Twenty-one tracks sit under the hero. Each lesson keeps its citation beside the English body.
Diagrams are study maps. The count in Contact Path is the atlas, and each card names its public page.
Flows are the animated subset: ladders, routing, architecture, deployment, migration, and troubleshooting trees.
Charts count lessons, minutes, and quiz items from the files in this repository. They are not a NiCE benchmark.
Cheat Codes are the one-page sheets. Each one links the page it paraphrases.
Ecosystem is the neighbor map: WFM, quality, CRM, Enlighten, APIs, and the UCCE and Avaya bridges, each with its own citation.
The routing simulator uses (time × acceleration) + initial priority. Personal Connection mode forces acceleration to 0.
The Studio builder exports classroom JSON with notOfficialStudioExport set. It is not an official Studio script.
Turn the map and switch a failure on to see that path go red. If motion is reduced, the flat list stays.

quizzes.ask: Initial priority 4, acceleration 1, waiting 3 minutes. What is overall priority?
quizzes.why: Overall priority is (time × acceleration) + initial priority, so (3 × 1) + 4 = 7.

quizzes.ask: Where does the ports page say an IP voice hardphone SIP-registers?
quizzes.why: The ports page requires permission to SIP-register to destination ports 5060 and 5061. NTP 123 is the hardphone clock, not the register.
